richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Chinsurah

c: Chinsurah, the headquarters of Hooghly district, is an old river town on the west bank of the Hooghly with a Dutch past that still shows in some of its buildings. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Chinsurah to schools, colleges, municipal parks, riverside walkways, clubs and housing societies. We build the machines at our Vasai factory, about 1,650 km away, and deliver them by road.

In an older town, an open gym often goes into an existing park or a riverside strip that already has trees, benches and old walls around it. Bright primary colours can look out of place in that setting. We roto-mould parts in more than 15 shades, so you can pick muted greens, greys or browns that sit quietly next to old buildings. The climate is humid with a heavy monsoon, so frames are galvanised pipe and the seats and handles are plastic.

items.q: Can we choose colours that suit an old town park?
items.a: Yes. We roto-mould parts in more than 15 shades. Tell us the look you want and we will suggest a colour scheme on the quote before manufacture.

items.q: Can outdoor gym machines go along a narrow riverside path?
items.a: Yes. We place single machines in small groups with enough clear space for walkers to pass. Send us the width and length of the path and some photos.
Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai, and our team or a dealer covering eastern India installs the machines, grouted or self-standing depending on the ground.
